item.title: 4-year-old child hospitalized after being struck in head by bottle reportedly thrown from float during Zulu parade
item.description: A 4-year-old child is still recovering after reportedly being struck in the head with a glass bottle thrown from a float during the Krewe of Zulu parade on Mardi Gras Day.

item.description: A water service interruption was declared in Jefferson Parish on Wednesday, Feb. 18.

item.title: Crawfish prices dropping at start of Lent
item.description: The early days of the crawfish season saw high prices due to the extreme cold snap and labor shortages. Now the warmer weather is starting to have an effect on the supply which is leading to lower prices, which is a trend that is expected to continue in the near future.
